components.name: Default Button
components.description: Neutral seamed button for ordinary actions such as Pause agent.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; font:550 13px/1.2 var(--sans, 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif); padding:8px 14px; border-radius:5px; border:1px solid var(--border-strong); background:var(--surface-1); color:var(--text-primary); cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-btn:hover { background:var(--surface-2); border-color:var(--text-muted); } .ds-btn:active { background:var(--surface-3); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one forward action in a form or dialog.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font:550 13px/1.2 var(--sans, 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif); padding:8px 14px; border-radius:5px; border:1px solid var(--accent); background:var(--accent); color:var(--accent-ink); cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s, border-color .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--accent-2); border-color:var(--accent-2); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive control: dashed red outline that fills only on deliberate hover or focus.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { font:650 13px/1.2 var(--sans, 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif); padding:8px 14px; border-radius:5px; border:1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--critical-mark) 75%, transparent); background:transparent; color:var(--critical); cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s, border-color .15s, color .15s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover, .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { background:var(--critical-mark); border-style:solid; border-color:var(--critical-mark); color:#fff; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Kill Cell
components.description: The emergency stop standing alone behind a seam at the far right of the top bar.
components.css: .ds-kill-row { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:12px 16px; background:var(--bg); } .ds-kill-pause { font:550 13px/1.2 var(--sans, 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif); padding:8px 14px; border-radius:5px; border:1px solid var(--border-strong); background:var(--surface-1); color:var(--text-primary); } .ds-kill-cell { display:flex; align-items:center; margin-left:16px; padding-left:16px; border-left:1px solid var(--border-strong); } .ds-kill-stop { font:650 13px/1.2 var(--sans, 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing:.01em; padding:8px 14px; border-radius:5px; border:1px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--critical-mark) 75%, transparent); background:transparent; color:var(--critical); cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s, color .15s; } .ds-kill-stop:hover, .ds-kill-stop:focus-visible { background:var(--critical-mark); border-style:solid; border-color:var(--critical-mark); color:#fff; }

components.name: Status Tag
components.description: Mode and state tags: 4px corners, mono text, a state dot; never a pill.
components.html: PAPER · no real money SYNTHETIC market data passed probe
components.css: .ds-tag { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; font:550 12px/1.5 var(--mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); letter-spacing:-.01em; padding:3px 10px; border-radius:4px; background:var(--surface-2); border:1px solid var(--border); color:var(--text-secondary); white-space:nowrap; } .ds-tag i { width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--text-muted); } .ds-tag-paper { background:var(--surface-1); border-color:var(--text-muted); color:var(--text-primary); font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.04em; } .ds-tag-warn { color:var(--warning); } .ds-tag-warn i { background:var(--warning-mark); } .ds-tag-pass { background:var(--good-soft); border-color:transparent; color:var(--good); } .ds-tag-pass i { background:var(--good-mark); } .ds-tag-probe { color:var(--violet); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--violet) 14%, transparent); border-color:transparent; }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Graphite panel with a seam header and small tracked-capital title.
components.html:
Trading pipeline

last 7 days
3 tested · net of costs
components.css: .ds-panel { background:var(--surface-1); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:6px; font:400 14px/1.55 var(--sans, 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif); color:var(--text-primary); } .ds-panel-h { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; min-height:48px; padding:10px 20px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); } .ds-panel-h h2 { margin:0; flex:1; font:650 12.5px/1.3 var(--sans, 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.09em; color:var(--text-secondary); } .ds-panel-note { font:12px var(--mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); color:var(--text-secondary); padding:3px 9px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:4px; background:var(--surface-2); } .ds-panel-b { padding:18px 20px 20px; } .ds-fig { font:500 24px/1.1 var(--mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); letter-spacing:-.03em; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-muted { color:var(--text-muted); }

components.name: Check-in Verdict
components.description: The first answer on every screen: one verdict line tinted toward its state hue.
components.html: 1 probe live. Waiting for entry signals on the next bar close. Forward test only, not evidence of an edge.
components.css: .ds-checkin { --v:var(--violet); display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:flex-start; padding:18px 22px; border-radius:6px; border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--v) 30%, var(--border)); background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--v) 8%, var(--surface-1)); } .ds-checkin-dot { width:9px; height:9px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--v); margin-top:10px; flex:none; } .ds-checkin p { margin:0; font:600 22px/1.35 var(--sans, 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing:-.015em; color:var(--text-primary); }

components.name: Unit Input
components.description: Limit field: mono value with a seamed unit cell and blue focus halo.
components.css: .ds-field { display:block; font:550 12.5px var(--sans, 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif); color:var(--text-secondary); } .ds-field > span:first-child { display:block; margin-bottom:5px; } .ds-unit { display:flex; border:1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius:5px; background:var(--surface-1); transition:border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-unit:focus-within { border-color:var(--accent); box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--accent-soft); } .ds-unit input { flex:1; min-width:0; border:0; background:transparent; padding:8px 11px; font:13.5px var(--mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); color:var(--text-primary); outline:none; } .ds-unit b { display:grid; place-items:center; padding:0 10px; font:400 13px var(--mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); color:var(--text-muted); border-left:1px solid var(--border); }

components.name: Rail Navigation
components.description: Left rail items with stroked icons and mono counts; live counts in cyan, probes in violet.
components.html: OverviewPipeline1 live
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:2px; width:220px; padding:8px; background:var(--bg); } .ds-nav-item { display:flex; gap:11px; align-items:center; min-height:40px; padding:9px 12px; border-radius:5px; font:500 13.5px var(--sans, 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif); color:var(--text-secondary); text-decoration:none; transition:background .15s, color .15s; } .ds-nav-item svg { width:18px; height:18px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.6; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--text-primary); } .ds-nav-item.is-active { color:var(--accent); background:var(--surface-2); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--border); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-nav-count { margin-left:auto; font:12px var(--mono, 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace); padding:1px 7px; border-radius:4px; background:var(--chip); color:var(--text-muted); } .ds-nav-count.is-live { color:var(--live); background:var(--live-soft); }

narrative.overview:
QuantDesk is a working console, not a showcase. Graphite panels sit on a near-black ground, divided by 1px hairline seams; there is almost no decoration, and colour is borrowed from code syntax and spent only on state. The operator reads one verdict line, then the live and probe state, then figures that always carry their costs and limits beside them. Density is high and calm: small tracked-capital panel titles, mono figures in fixed columns, tags rather than pills.

The system is dark-first (the house theme is dark by default) with a full "daylight" variant that keeps the same seams, roles and hierarchy on pale grey ground. Depth comes from tonal steps between ground, panel and raised panel, never from resting shadows. The one theatrical gesture is the kill cell: the emergency stop stands alone behind a seam, set apart by empty space, drawn as a dashed red outline that fills only when deliberately hovered or focused.

It rejects the soft SaaS dashboard: glow backgrounds, gradient tiles, pill-shaped everything and shadowed round cards.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite tonal layering with 1px seams instead of shadows.
Syntax-derived state colour; neutral ink for everything that is not state.
One reserved cyan for capital that is live right now.
Hanken Grotesk for words, JetBrains Mono for every figure.
Destructive controls outlined and dashed until intent is shown.

rules.name: The Reserved Ink Rule
rules.body: Live Cyan marks capital that is live right now and nothing else. If no sleeve is live, no cyan appears on the screen.

rules.name: The State-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Direction is carried by sign and drawn marks, not colour: positive and negative returns both render in Ink. Hue is spent on state (passed, probe, warning, failed, live), never on decoration.

rules.name: The Probe Is Not Proof Rule
rules.body: Probes are violet everywhere they appear. They never take green.

rules.name: The Every Figure Is Mono Rule
rules.body: Every number, money value, percentage, timestamp, count and unit is set in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals, so columns never move and values change in place.

rules.name: The Seams Not Shadows Rule
rules.body: A panel is separated from the page by a 1px seam and one tonal step. If a resting surface needs a shadow to be seen, the tonal step is wrong.

dos: **Do** separate surfaces with a 1px seam and one tonal step (graphite-ground, panel, panel-raised).
**Do** set every figure, unit, timestamp and count in JetBrains Mono with tabular numerals.
**Do** keep Live Cyan for capital that is live right now; draw the account line in Ink when nothing is live.
**Do** colour probes violet everywhere and show costs and limits beside the numbers they qualify.
**Do** draw destructive controls as dashed red outlines that fill only on hover or focus, isolated from neighbouring controls, and confirm them in a dialog.
**Do** keep the PAPER tag visible on every screen in both themes.
**Do** cancel or strike through retired and stopped items rather than removing them.
donts: **Don't** use glow backgrounds, gradient tiles, pill shapes or shadowed round cards.
**Don't** put a resting shadow on a panel; overlays (drawer, dialog, toast) are the only lifted surfaces.
**Don't** colour gains and losses green and red; sign and drawn marks carry direction.
**Don't** use green for probes or anything not yet affirmed by evidence.
**Don't** use a radius above 6px or a fully rounded shape for anything except indicator dots.
